relations: Hand holding bare wire handle moves the sparkler, so its tilt and position can change while burning continues.
Glowing coated tip emits sparks; as the tip moves, spark streaks and bursts shift relative to the background.
As the sparkler tilts, spark fans can change from horizontal streaks to radiating bursts and sparse sprays.
Starbursts may pop away from the tip while short streaks can fall below it against the blurred grass.
caption: The video captures a hand holding a burning sparkler by its bare wire handle at the lower-left edge, against a blurred backdrop of green grass and a dark tree line. The coated tip glows as a bright white-yellow point near the center, continuously throwing off thin orange sparks and streaks. Throughout the clip the hand actively moves the stick, shifting its tilt and position while the spark pattern changes from a long horizontal streak to upright fans and dense radiating bursts. Isolated starbursts pop away from the tip at the left and top, and short falling streaks drop below it. The central glow swells into a tight bright cluster and then loosens into a sparser spray. The burning continues without a visible start or finish within the excerpt.
